decision.text: The voyage: commit the red proof; cross TICKETME->BUILDME at cairn/devices/trouble (the component dir holding intention+why.json) through cairn.tools.base.transitions.emit(..., ticket='63e6eb836769', actor='cc', why=...), the returned cursor written onto the ticket through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(..., verb='cast'); build D2 and D3; run bin/cairn test cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_a_cli_clear_carries_the_hand.py twice (green both times) and bin/cairn test cairn/devices/trouble/proofs (all green); commit; cross BUILDME->PROVEME with proven_by=['cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_a_cli_clear_carries_the_hand.py']; bin/cairn test --seal cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_a_cli_clear_carries_the_hand.py; timeout 590 bin/cairn test --hollow 63e6eb836769 --seal, which reverts cairn/devices/trouble/0/bin/trouble (reds tooth 2) and cairn/devices/trouble/trouble.py (reds tooth 1); verdict; push both repos; PROVED.
